text_block_list.text:
In the paddock for the Hyacinth Stakes, 
Agnes Digital was staring intensely at the 
other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: Make sure you don't jump at it.
Make sure you don't jump at it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I won't take the bait, not today! No, not 
today either! I don't have time for that 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chan is as precious and sublime 
as always, but... was it really like this 
before?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's like, you know... what used to be a 
sparkling, precious sight now looks 
fiercely, blindingly precious...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gets so serious before a race, 
and that intensity is just irresistible, 
though maybe I shouldn't be saying it's 
irresistible...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... beyond that preciousness, 
there's something even purer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No no no no, perish the thought! I 
couldn't possibly do something so 
audacious!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today, however, I'd like to bear witness 
to an Umamusume's true face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course I won't get involved! I won't 
interfere either! Oshi activities should 
be quiet, strictly hands-off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“Still... as close as possible, closer 
than before!”

Still a bystander as always. But... her 
eyes held a bit more seriousness than 
usual.
